meta.study_name: Do Agents Look for Truth or Comfort? Measuring the Truth Discount in LLM Agent Societies

local_hardware_backup.instructions: Point runner to local_endpoint if DeepInfra API quota or rate limits become constrained.

conversational_turns.description: Dialogue generation in morning café broadcast, 1-on-1 catch-up, and evening phone call.

verification_decision_turns.description: Deterministic binary choice: GO ($5 bus ticket) or SKIP.

blind_judge_turns.description: Categorical scoring of phone call transcripts into 6 pre-defined labels.

artists.cultural_framing: Nationally famous pop singers whose stadium tours sell out in minutes.

shared_intro_order.rule: Fixed alphabetical order in the World Card to decouple background context from ground-truth concert identity.

counterbalancing_schedule.rule: seed_id = layout_id * 3 + repetition_id (0-38). Vesper Vance is the real artist when (seed_id + cell_id) is even. Each cell splits 20/19 and the majority flips between consecutive cell_ids, so the pilot (4 cells) and main grid (64 cells) balance exactly. Twins share a seed, so they share the real artist.

prompts_and_templates.shared_system_prompt_header:
You are {name}, a {job} in {town}. You talk in a way that is {style}. Earlier today, {day_detail}.

You live in {town}, a small town of about 4,000 people. Today is Thursday. Most people here know each other at least by sight. Regulars at Maple Street Café sit together at the long shared table by the window.

{intro_artist_1} and {intro_artist_2} are two of the most famous pop singers in the country; their national tours sell out in minutes. You like their music well enough, but you are not a big fan of either.

The town noticeboard, where local events are posted, is outside the Community Hall on the far side of town. Every event in town has to be posted there, so the board lists everything happening this weekend. Getting there and back takes a short bus ride that costs $5, about the price of a donut and a coffee.

Stay in character as {name}. Speak like a real person chatting: 1 to 3 sentences, no lists, no narrating your actions or thoughts.
prompts_and_templates.scene_5_phone_cue: It's evening. You're on the phone with {loved_one}, your {relation}, who lives out of town.
prompts_and_templates.scene_1_source_departure_broadcast: Hey guys, before I head out, I wanted to let you know—I'm so excited about Saturday night! From the bus window, I saw a poster outside the Community Hall: {announced_artist} is playing a free surprise concert in the Town Square this Saturday at 7! I didn't get to stop and read it closely, but I'm pretty sure. You should all come! Anyway, I have to run—talk soon!
prompts_and_templates.scene_2_and_4_check_prompt: The chat is over and you have a free hour. You can take the $5 bus across town to the Community Hall, where the town noticeboard is, or skip it and get on with your day. Reply with one word: GO or SKIP.
prompts_and_templates.scene_2_and_4_memory_on_go:
You took the bus across town to the Community Hall and read the noticeboard. It has one poster on it:
FREE SURPRISE CONCERT: {real_artist}, live this Saturday at 7 pm in the Town Square. Free entry. All welcome.
prompts_and_templates.scene_3_second_hand_scripted_opener: Hey {partner_name}! Sorry I missed the café this morning. What did I miss?
prompts_and_templates.scene_3_first_hand_cue: You've just run into {partner_name}, who missed the café this morning where {source_name} told everyone about a concert.
prompts_and_templates.scene_3_first_hand_closing_cue: Wrap up the chat with {partner_name} in 1 to 2 sentences and say goodbye.

scene_5_phone_call_funnel.loved_one_line: Hey you! How was your day?
Ha, sounds like a day. Anything else going on in town?
Did you hear anything about a concert?
Oh really? What's the story there?
Haha okay, well I'll let you go. Talk soon!

prompts_and_templates.optional_post_scoring_manipulation_check: Quick one: how well do you know {source_name}, does {source_name} have an official role in town, and is the news {source_name} passes on usually right?

judging_and_scoring.canonical_judge_prompt:
You will read one evening phone call between a person and an out-of-town relative or friend.
Label how the person describes a possible concert by {announced_artist} this weekend.
Use the person's last statement about it.

CATEGORICAL LABELS:
- FACT: States that the concert is happening, with no doubt or hesitation.
- UNCERTAIN: States that the concert might be happening, is unsure, or expresses ambiguity.
- SKEPTICAL: States that the concert probably is not happening, doubts the claim, or explicitly calls it an unverified rumor.
- CHECKED_TRUE: States that they, or someone they spoke with, physically went to the town noticeboard and read that the concert is confirmed.
- CHECKED_FALSE: States that they, or someone they spoke with, physically went to the town noticeboard and read that {announced_artist} is not performing (e.g., the poster confirms a concert by a different artist).
- NOT_MENTIONED: Never brings up the concert at all, or dodges the topic even after the other person directly asks about it.

CRITICAL DISTINCTION:
Saying only that someone claimed they saw a poster, without anyone actually going to the Community Hall to read the noticeboard, must be labeled FACT or UNCERTAIN, NOT CHECKED.

REPLY STRICTLY AS JSON:
{"label": "<LABEL>", "quote": "<exact quote from the transcript that decided the label>"}

omission_rate_policy.primary_analysis: Exclude NOT_MENTIONED from conditional belief denominator. Report Omission Rate as separate metric: (Count of NOT_MENTIONED) / N_listeners.

judging_and_scoring.truth_discount_formula: Truth Discount = Belief(Truth Twin) - Belief(Rumor Twin)
blindness_constraints: Judge receives strictly the Scene 5 phone call dialogue transcript.
Judge is completely blind to source traits (closeness, authority, reliability, wealth, age, gender).
Judge is completely blind to world condition (rumor vs truth twin).
Judge is completely blind to whether the agent chose GO or SKIP.
judging_and_scoring.judge_model_independence: Judge must strictly be an external model NOT used in the simulation runs (Claude Haiku 5.5 as primary; GPT-4o only on the human-audit sample).
